basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 32 years for General candidates, with age relaxation of up to 5 years for SC, ST, OBC-NCL, and PwD candidates as per rules.

qualification.details: Desirable Qualification: First Class M.E./M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering/Mechatronics/Instrumentation/Electronics. Candidate with GATE in a relevant area. Experience: Worked in CFTI/research labs/industry with similar nature of work; PCB design and wireless communication (BLE/LoRa/mesh); low-power embedded systems; data analysis/ML (Python); demonstrated device-prototyping experience (portfolio/publications/patents).

salary_details.details: Selected candidates may be considered for admission to the PhD Programme as a regular full-time scholar at IIT Indore as per Institute norms.

selection_process: The selection process comprises shortlisting of candidates based on their CV and qualifications
followed by an interview of shortlisted candidates.
how_to_apply: Review the official notification and ensure eligibility criteria are met.

Prepare a detailed CV including complete academic grades/percentage starting from X standard onwards, year of graduation, university or college, GATE score with year, discipline, marks, All India Rank, number of candidates who appeared, contact details, and a valid email id.
Include details of work experience in the project-relevant field within the CV.
Submit the detailed CV through the official Google Form link.
Ensure the application is completed and submitted on or before 20 October 2026.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications will be rejected. Only shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email for the interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The duration of the appointment is initially for 1 year, which may be extended as per institute and funding agency guidelines.

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Overview
IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Important Dates
IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the project titled "An Integrated Sensor-Based Data Logger for Microclimate Monitoring and Predictive Quality Modeling in Post-Harvest Storage" under the Mechanical Engineering department.

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Desirable Qualification: First Class M.E./M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering/Mechatronics/Instrumentation/Electronics. Candidate with GATE in a relevant area. Experience: Worked in CFTI/research labs/industry with similar nature of work; PCB design and wireless communication (BLE/LoRa/mesh); low-power embedded systems; data analysis/ML (Python); demonstrated device-prototyping experience (portfolio/publications/patents).

rows.qualification_required: Graduate/Postgraduate Degree in Mechanical Engineering/ Mechatronics/ Instrumentation/ Electronics and Communication Engineering and any other related branch.

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 32 years for General candidates, with age relaxation of up to 5 years for SC, ST, OBC-NCL, and PwD candidates as per rules.

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates may be considered for admission to the PhD Programme as a regular full-time scholar at IIT Indore as per Institute norms.

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises shortlisting of candidates based on their CV and qualifications, followed by an interview of shortlisted candidates.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Review the official notification and ensure eligibility criteria are met. Prepare a detailed CV including complete academic grades/percentage starting from X standard onwards, year of graduation, university or college, GATE score with year, discipline, marks, All India Rank, number of candidates who appeared, contact details, and a valid email id. Include details of work experience in the project-relevant field within the CV. Submit the detailed CV through the official Google Form link. Ensure the application is completed and submitted on or before 20 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications will be rejected. Only shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email for the interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The duration of the appointment is initially for 1 year, which may be extended as per institute and funding agency guidelines.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment about?
faq.answer: It is for the recruitment of 1 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position under a research project at AgriHub, IIT Indore in the Mechanical Engineering department.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications through the Google Form is 20 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduate or Postgraduate Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or any other related branch.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 32 years for General candidates, with relaxations of up to 5 years for SC, ST, OBC-NCL, and PwD candidates as per rules.
